# goslop text fixture — nox session delegates to tests_impl (niquests noxfile FP)
lang: python
file: noxfile.py
---
import nox

def tests_impl(session, cohabitation=None):
    session.run("pytest")

@nox.session
def test_cohabitation(session):
    tests_impl(session, cohabitation=True)
    tests_impl(session, cohabitation=None)
